policy: Prefer CI-only immutable downloads verified by size and SHA-256; preserve per-file attribution/licenses with derived artifacts. No private documents, no corpus files deployed to application.
limits: Not an anonymized customer corpus; public examples and scans plus externally synthesized fixtures.
Real photographed invoices, handwriting, diverse encrypted/signed forms and physical device interactions remain unverified.
A mixed-page assembly made from these sources is a derived test fixture, not an independently authored mixed production PDF.
